Question Choices: What are "buckets" in a histogram?  (A) The tallest bars in the graph.    (B) The total number of data points.   (C) Groups or intervals of data values
Solution: Buckets are intervals (ranges) that group data together instead of listing exact values.

Question Choices: A histogram shows screen time: Class A has 4 students at 2-3 hours and 3 at 3-4 hours; Class B has 6 at 2-3 hours and 5 at 3-4 hours. Which class has more students with 2 or more hours of screen time?
Hints: Add the buckets ≥ 2 for each class
Solution: Class A: 4 + 3 = 7. Class B: 6 + 5 = 11 -> Class B

Question Choices: In Class B, 8 students are in the 2-3 bucket and 5 students are in the 1-2 bucket. How many more students are in 2-3 than 1-2?
A histogram has buckets 0-29 with 3 values, 30-59 with 9 values, and 60-89 with 5 values. Which statement is correct? (A) Most data is in 0-29.   (B) Most data is in 30-59   (C) All buckets are equal
Solution: 9 is the highest -> most data in 30-59

Question Choices: A histogram of books read shows: 0-2 books: 4 students, 3-5 books: 11 students, 6-8 books: 3 students, 9-11 books: 2 students. Which statement is TRUE? (A) Most students read more than 6 books   (B) All students read at least 3 books   (C) Most students read between 3-5 books
Solution: Largest frequency = 11 (3-5 bucket) -> most students are in this range
